配额审核模式。
description.en:

This parameter is deprecated. Do not use it.

The approval mode of the quota.

description.zh:
配额申请的值。

> - 根据[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中目标配额的`TotalUsage`（配额用量）和`ApplicableRange`（配额项可申请范围）来设置配额申请值。
> - 配额申请由各云产品的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由。
description.en:
The value for the quota request.

> - Set this parameter based on the `TotalUsage` and `ApplicableRange` parameters for the target quota. For more information, see [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).
>
> - The technical support team of each Alibaba Cloud service reviews quota increase requests. To improve your chance of success, specify a reasonable value and a detailed reason for your request.

description.zh:
配额维度。
配额项的属性，维度（Dimensions）+配额ID（QuotaActionCode）确定唯一的配额项。
> 部分云产品维度必填。您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回参数`Requisite`表示该维度是否必填。
description.en:
The quota dimensions.
A quota is uniquely identified by the combination of Dimensions and QuotaActionCode.

> This parameter is required for some Alibaba Cloud services. To query the dimensions that an Alibaba Cloud service supports, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The `Requisite` parameter in the response indicates whether a dimension is required.

description.zh:
配额维度的Key。

> `Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数，您可以通过[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N。
description.en:
The key of the quota dimension.

> You must specify `Dimensions.N.Key` and `Dimensions.N.Value` in pairs. The value of N is determined by the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud service supports. To query the dimensions that an Alibaba Cloud service supports, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The value of N is the number of elements in the returned array.

description.zh:
配额维度的Value。

> `Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数，您可以通过[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N。
description.en:
The value of the quota dimension.

> You must specify `Dimensions.N.Key` and `Dimensions.N.Value` in pairs. The value of N is determined by the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud service supports. To query the dimensions that an Alibaba Cloud service supports, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The value of N is the number of elements in the returned array.

description.zh:
配额生效的UTC时间。
该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。 

> 当您未选择生效时间时，默认为当前配额开始时间起99年。
description.en:
The UTC time when the quota takes effect.
This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel).

> If you do not specify this parameter, the quota takes effect at the time of submission.
The language of the notification for the quota alert.

description.zh:
配额失效的UTC时间。
该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。 

> 当您未选择失效时间时，默认为提交时间。
description.en:
The UTC time when the quota expires.
This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel).

> If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 99 years after the time specified by \`EffectiveTime\`.

description.zh:
配额申请结果是否发送通知。取值：

- 0（默认值）：否。
- 3：是。
description.en:
Specifies whether to send a notification for the quota request. Valid values:

- 0 (default): no.

- 3: yes.

description.zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中的`ProductCode`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> For more information, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).

description.zh:
配额ID。

> 关于如何获取云产品的配额ID，请参见[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中的`QuotaActionCode`。
description.en:
The quota ID.

> For more information, see the `QuotaActionCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).

The type of the quota.

Default value: CommonQuota.

description.zh:
配额申请的原因。

> 配额申请由各云产品的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由。
description.en:
The reason for the quota increase request.

> The technical support team of each Alibaba Cloud service reviews quota increase requests. To improve your chance of success, specify a reasonable value and a detailed reason for your request.

descriptions.zh: > 创建配额提升申请后，您可以调用[ListQuotaApplications](~~440568~~)接口查看审批结果，当`Status`显示为`Agree`时，表示审批通过。
descriptions.en: > After you create a quota increase request, you can call the [ListQuotaApplications](~~440568~~) operation to check the approval result. The request is approved if the value of the `Status` parameter is `Agree`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas create-quota-application --product-code ecs --quota-action-code q_security-groups --desire-value 804.0 --reason Scale_Out --notice-type 0 --dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --quota-category CommonQuota --audit-mode Sync --env-language zh --expire-time 2021-01-20T09:25:56Z --effective-time 2021-01-19T09:25:56Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas CreateQuotaApplication --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'q_security-groups' --Dimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --Dimensions.1.Key regionId --AuditMode Sync --ProductCode ecs --EffectiveTime '2021-01-19T09:25:56Z' --QuotaCategory CommonQuota --NoticeType 0 --DesireValue '804.0' --ExpireTime '2021-01-20T09:25:56Z' --Reason Scale_Out --EnvLanguage zh
